name: Five Nights at Freddy's (Clickteam Fusion 2.5 family)
exe_layout: PE32 stub (~1 MB) + ~230 MB overlay beginning with the 'wwww' pack marker, then PAMU (Unicode) game data - verified on FNAF 1
status: FNAF 1-4, Sister Location, Pizzeria Simulator packaged as .app bundles (2026-11-20) around a user-built KlikCore2; FNAF 1 confirmed running by the user; the others untested

candidates.name: KlikCore2 (Jackhiles/KlikCore2)
candidates.loads: compiled .exe directly (PE overlay -> wwww pack -> PAME/PAMU)
candidates.macos: not mentioned (Windows/Linux/Android documented); Macroquad is cross-platform
candidates.maturity: README milestone table all 'done'; 0 stars; extension objects are the most common gap; FNAF compatibility not stated

candidates.name: NuclearRT (nuclearrt/nuclearrt)
candidates.loads: needs a Fusion-side exporter on Windows with Clickteam Fusion 2.5 installed (project, not a finished exe)
candidates.maturity: 'not ready for general use'; sub-applications unsupported

candidates.name: CTFAK2.0 / NebulaFD
candidates.note: decompile exe to MFA/assets; not players

candidates.name: Chowdren
candidates.kind: Fusion->C++ runtime; GPL until 2016, then private/commercial; needs the Fusion project, macOS command line only

recommendation: Try KlikCore2 first (it reads the exe as-is). Review the source before building (unknown author, no license text, downloads a SoundFont on first run). Fallback: CrossOver tuning.
safety_note: KlikCore2 is third-party code that is not built or run by this toolkit; review it and build it yourself.
packaging: tools/make_fusion_app.py wraps a game folder (APFS clone) + the klikcore binary + an icon extracted from the exe into a signed .app; launcher sets KLIKCORE_DISCORD=off by default. Output used: <workdir>/fnaf/apps/
